Package io.kaleido.workflowengine.sdk.errors

Class SDKErrors

java.lang.Object
io.kaleido.workflowengine.sdk.errors.SDKErrors
public final class SDKErrors extends Object
SDK error message catalog. The KA1406XX codes are shared across the Kaleido SDK family and must stay aligned with the other language SDKs.
